---
title: "Have you published a paper about your software? (For example in journals such as JOSS or Software-x)"
question_id: paper3mod_0
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| file: ../R/_load_common.R
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
question_code <- "paper3mod_0"
response_levels <- c("False", "True")

nordic_countries <- c(
  "Finland", "Norway", "Sweden", "Denmark", "Iceland", "Estonia"
)
country_groups <- list(
  Nordics = nordic_countries,
  Germany = "Germany",
  Netherlands = "Netherlands"
)
plot_countries <- countries_from_groups(country_groups)

df <- load_filtered_tf(plot_countries)
likert_cols <- question_code
```

## Nordics

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| results: asis

df_nordics <- load_filtered_tf(nordic_countries)

print_likert_items(
  df_nordics,
  likert_cols,
  meta = cols,
  levels = response_levels,
  empty_message = "No responses available for Nordic countries in the current filter."
)
```

### Statistics by age group

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

df_nordics <- load_filtered_tf(nordic_countries)

print_likert_items(
  df_nordics,
  likert_cols,
  meta = cols,
  group_by = "age_group",
  include_plot = FALSE,
  heading_level = 4L,
  levels = response_levels,
  empty_message = "No responses available for Nordic countries in the current filter."
)
```
